name: run_code_in_browser
description: Run a TypeScript snippet inside the running app's preview document in the user's open Floot editor and return the string it returns. `document` and `window` are the app's own DOM: measure elements, read computed styles and rendered output, or click a button and read the result. Runs at the project root, so project files import by relative path. The same `_floot` helpers as run_code_in_vm are available. Needs the project open in the editor (fails fast otherwise); prefer run_code_in_vm when the DOM is not needed. Typed text input and long multi-step flows are unreliable here: leave those to the user.
